messages.subject: For José Muñoz | Mobility, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Hyundai Motor Global PR Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. José Muñoz, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Hyundai Motor's transformation across electrification, hydrogen, smart manufacturing and future mobility requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and strategic partners. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support Hyundai Motor's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Hyundai Motor Company.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
